annotations.title: Show the enforcement rules in the order they apply

description:
Return the six enforcement rules in the exact order they are applied, each with a plain-language reason it exists. Takes no mandate and no action.

Use when a refusal did not make sense, or before explaining a denial to someone whose mandate was rejected. A refusal you cannot explain is one nobody will trust.

Do NOT use it to check an action — it performs no check, and cannot predict which rule will fire, only the order they are tried in.

Constant output, fully idempotent, opens no files, contacts no host.
name: drift_explain
